sentences.en: The rocket landed sufficiently gently to avoid breaking its instruments.
sentences.zh: 火箭着陆时非常轻柔，没有损坏其仪器。

sentences.en: Treat the sprout gently, as you would treat a baby.
sentences.zh: 对待嫩芽要温柔，就像对待婴儿一样。

sentences.en: Proceed strongly in the matter, but gently in the method!
sentences.zh: 在处理这件事上要坚定有力，但在方法上要温和！
